# AnyTool.online

AnyTool.online is a multilingual utility website with free calculators, Taiwan public-service tools, image/PDF utilities, QR tools and AI-assisted OCR.

Canonical site: https://anytool.online/
Languages:
- English: https://anytool.online/
- Traditional Chinese: https://anytool.online/zh-tw/
- Arabic: https://anytool.online/ar/
- Urdu: https://anytool.online/ur/

## Trust and sourcing
- Methodology: https://anytool.online/methodology
- Official sources: https://anytool.online/sources
- Privacy: https://anytool.online/privacy
- Contact: https://anytool.online/contact

Taiwan regulated calculations are deterministic and source-backed. AnyTool does not use generative AI to invent tax, insurance, wage, subsidy or eligibility rules. Source pages and verification dates are shown on regulated tools.

## Key Taiwan tools
- Take-home pay: https://anytool.online/tools/take-home-pay
- Labor insurance: https://anytool.online/tools/labor-insurance
- NHI premium: https://anytool.online/tools/nhi
- Income tax: https://anytool.online/tools/income-tax
- Overtime pay: https://anytool.online/tools/overtime-pay
- Minimum wage: https://anytool.online/tools/minimum-wage
- Employer cost: https://anytool.online/tools/employer-cost
- Passport / ARC photo maker: https://anytool.online/tools/taiwan-id-photo
- Elderly care subsidy & bed finder: https://anytool.online/tools/taiwan-elder-care

## File and AI tools
Image resize/conversion and PDF merge/split run locally in the browser where practical. AI OCR and structured receipt extraction require a signed-in account and report the provider used.

Sitemap: https://anytool.online/sitemap.xml


## Freshness and source monitoring
- Official-source pages for Taiwan wage, insurance, tax, passport/ARC photo and elderly-care information are checked by an automated weekly source monitor.
- When expected official markers disappear or a government page fails, the monitor opens a review issue instead of silently changing public formulas.
- Regulated calculator math is deterministic code; generative AI is used only for explanation or document extraction, not to invent legal rates.
- Elderly-care vacancy figures are labeled by source freshness. Users should call the institution before making a placement decision because availability can change.
